rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of mama-d-leau, River mother with serpent lower body and golden comb. Create one square PNG at least 1024 by 1024.
ANATOMY: One beautiful human female head with two eyes, two arms with five fingers each, torso fully covered in opaque unpatterned bronze-brown cloth, and one large snake body coiling continuously from the waist instead of legs. Long snaky hair, a narrow forked tongue briefly visible, and one plain golden comb with no inscriptions. [mama-d-leau-c03, mama-d-leau-c04, mama-d-leau-c07]
MOMENT: Emerge powerfully from the river and sweep a river current aside with the large snake coils while raising the comb through her long snaky hair; gaze commands the viewer.
POWER: Physical river displacement by her documented snake body, with river animals sheltering behind the coils; no conjured energy. [mama-d-leau-c02, mama-d-leau-c07]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, confrontational close framing; subject fills 80 percent of the image, unmistakable silhouette at 200 pixels. No unsupported giant scale, very close monumental composition only.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low-key warm moonlight or dusk source as appropriate, sharp rim light, deep walnut shadows, sparse contextual spray or dust; dark warm painterly palette with antique gold accent, no flat daylight.
SURFACE: tactile weathered natural materials, detailed rough skin, wet scales or coarse hair where anatomically appropriate; thick expressive oil brushwork and premium cinematic composition.
SETTING: Caribbean river, rocky bank and dark tropical foliage. [mama-d-leau-c01, mama-d-leau-c02, mama-d-leau-c09]
MOOD: Sacred protector and healer, benevolent yet overwhelming; dignified, never evil; overwhelming and imposing, never cute, calm, decorative or static. No modern costume.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, no lettering, no symbols, no glyphs or pseudo-glyphs, no inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs, fingers or eyes; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Background subordinate to subject.
